Marie is portrayed as a talented young musician whose primary motivation is to connect with her audience through genuine expression. She faces significant internal and external conflicts, as the pressures of the music industry challenge her sense of self and personal identity. Her character development is marked by a transformation from a budding artist into a self-assured icon. This growth is defined by her commitment to artistic integrity, which she ultimately uses her platform to advocate for.
